payload.title: Our Story | Patnam Pakodi, Hyderabad
payload.description: Discover the Guntur-style inspiration behind Patnam Pakodi, our four chicken pakodi flavours and our current home in Kukatpally, Hyderabad.
payload.heading: A familiar snack. A story of our own.
payload.intro: Patnam Pakodi brings Guntur-style chicken pakodi into the everyday rhythm of Hyderabad: bold spice, a satisfying crunch and time spent together.

sections.title: It begins with a love for pakodi.
sections.body:
Our story starts with a simple idea: bring the character of Guntur-style chicken pakodi to people who enjoy a good snack. The food, the spice and the moments around it are at the centre of Patnam Pakodi.

A snack can be a small part of the day and still be the part you look forward to. That is the feeling behind our name and the promise in our familiar line: Life Lo Spice Undali.

sections.title: Four flavours, each with a point of view.
sections.body:
Our current menu brings together Erra Karam, Pachi Mirchi, Miriyala and Chettinad Kodi Pakodi. Each starts with chicken pakodi and takes its flavour in a different direction.

We are giving these four flavours the spotlight. Explore the red chilli warmth, green chilli kick, peppery notes and Chettinad spice on our menu.

sections.title: Our home, right now: Kukatpally.
sections.body:
We are currently serving only in Kukatpally, Hyderabad. It is the place to get to know the food, ask our team about the flavours and make your next pakodi break a Patnam one.

As we explore franchise opportunities, our website will continue to show the branches that are actually serving. For today, that means Kukatpally.

sections.title: The idea behind our franchise.
sections.body:
The Patnam Pakodi franchise approach uses standard operating procedures: documented preparation steps and operator training. It is designed to reduce dependence on a specialist chef and give partners a clear operating process.

Our brochure describes four setup formats, with equipment and brand materials tailored to each. Prospective partners can discuss training, location suitability and the current operating terms directly with our team.

blocks.title: What inspires Patnam Pakodi?
blocks.text: Our brand story is rooted in Guntur-style chicken pakodi and the everyday food culture of Hyderabad. The current menu puts four chicken pakodi flavours at the centre of that story.

blocks.title: What does a chef-less operating model mean?
blocks.text: It means the franchise approach relies on documented preparation steps and operator training, with less dependence on a specialist chef. Ask the franchise team about the current training and operating process for your chosen format.

blocks.title: What are the franchise package prices?
blocks.text: The brochure lists Brand-Only at Rs 69,000, Cart at Rs 99,000, Cabin at Rs 1,50,000 and Shop Setup at Rs 3,00,000. Customized inclusions may change the price. Ask our team for a current written breakdown for your location.

blocks.title: How do I decide which format is right for me?
blocks.text: Compare your available space and the setup you need. The Cart is listed at 3 ft × 2.5 ft, the Cabin at 5 ft × 3 ft, and the Shop format includes seating. The Brand-Only package focuses on branding, kitchen items and starter stock. Discuss your location with the team before choosing.

blocks.title: What equipment and brand materials are included?
blocks.text: The brochure lists cooking and preparation equipment, measuring and storage items, signage and welcome kits by format. The sections above set out the differences; download the brochure for the complete package lists.

blocks.title: Do I need a professional chef?
blocks.text: The franchise approach uses documented preparation steps and operator training to reduce dependence on a specialist chef. Speak with the team about training, staffing and day-to-day responsibilities for your format.

blocks.title: Does the brochure describe today's food menu?
blocks.text: The brochure includes examples of broader food setups and branding. Our current customer menu focuses only on Erra Karam, Pachi Mirchi, Miriyala and Chettinad Kodi Pakodi. Confirm the menu for your proposed franchise with the team.

blocks.title: What should I confirm before committing?
blocks.text: Request the current package inclusions and a written cost breakdown. Discuss location approval, training, food-licence arrangements, ongoing supplies, operating costs, territory, royalty terms and launch timing with the team.

blocks.title: Where can I experience the food?
blocks.text: Our only serving branch is currently Kukatpally, Hyderabad. Check the branch details and call ahead before planning your visit.

blocks.title: What should I include in a franchise enquiry?
blocks.text: Tell us your name, contact number, city or proposed location, preferred format and any questions about the setup. You can use the franchise enquiry form or speak with our team directly.
